title: Twin-Court Treatise of the Paired Thunder
summary: A treatise of the twin-court on thunder cast in pairs from two sides, ending in a cleaving crossed stroke.

title: Hawk-Stoop Canon of the Azure Bolt
summary: A canon of the hawk and the azure bolt that teaches lightning loosed in a dive and ends in a descent too fast to see.

title: Basin Court Manual of the Gathered Charge
summary: Teaches the long gathering of charge in the body and field until one discharge can empty it all.

title: River-Run Canon of the Long Lightning
summary: A canon of lightning cast far down a line of charge like a river, from the reaching spark to the long lance.

title: Azure Treatise on the Sundering Arc
summary: Teaches the arc that finds the seam of a guard, a plate or a stance and splits it open.

title: Great Book of the Two-Voiced Thunder
summary: Teaches thunder with a low voice and a high voice, call and reply, that join in a duet of ruin.

title: Oath-Book of the Held Thunder
summary: An oath-book of thunder withheld for a long time and loosed at once on a sworn mark.

title: Plateau Canon of the Sworn Lightning
summary: Teaches lightning pledged to a target before it is cast, from the pledged spark to the binding bolt.

title: Treatise on the Bearing Taken in Thunder
summary: Teaches a bearing taken and held in the middle of thunder, so every bolt goes unerringly where it was set.

title: Unwalled Canon of the Wide Bolt
summary: Teaches lightning spread wide and kept open to the whole field, ending in a bolt that covers all the ground.

title: Book of the Oath Kept Under Thunder
summary: A book of the keeper's discipline that holds a standing guard under thunder and stores a strike to return.

title: Wind-Sworn Canon of the Last Peal
summary: A wind-sworn canon of closing moves that finish a fight, ending in a verdict that no guard turns.
